title: Determine exact ordinary Toeplitz generator counts for tensor Gaussian kernels and their inverses
body:
## Result and relevance
Proves exact ordinary displacement rank and minimum lower-times-upper Toeplitz generator count 2T/n_fast for normalized tensor Gaussian kernels and their inverses; best lexicographic axis order gives 2T/max n_i. This identifies a missing representation obligation in grouped recovery.

## Pins and novelty
Canonical base e54523517d0f03e58352e647c403a5af3e525a57. Extends the retained shallow generator mechanism with explicit boundary minors, Gaussian invertibility and inverse Schur/persymmetry proof. Credits the normalized-core sources and #5566, #5571, #6905; no literature-wide priority claim.

## Reproduction and checks
Run `python3 -B scripts/research_package.py --package research/tensor-gaussian-displacement-rank`. Exact rational normal/-O replay, selected-minor Bareiss checks, generator reconstruction and scope controls pass. Separate proof review is in REVIEW.md. Committed bytes/modes and export checks pass. Full-history gate is not claimed for the shallow checkout; exact canonical provenance and base ancestry were checked.

## Limits and kappa
A representation result, not a runtime lower bound. Arbitrary permutations, approximate rank, paid gauges and the complete recovery caller remain open. No new kappa: selected 0.00363005817 and all five assumptions remain.

## Credit
Prepared for @CubeJerry with substantial OpenAI assistance; predecessor authors and classical structured-matrix work are credited. Separate agent review is not human/formal acceptance.

[Full proof, dependencies, checks and open obligations](https://github.com/CubeJerry/integer-mult-bounds/blob/326844a3e0c570fdafa4f3737095cd37154743a6/research/tensor-gaussian-displacement-rank/PR-DESCRIPTION.md).

title: Prove that Cp-bit rounding preserves the ordinary generator obstruction for normalized Gaussian tensors
body:
## Result and relevance
Proves explicit perturbation margins preserving at least2T/n_fast ordinary Toeplitz generator terms for normalized Gaussian tensors and inverse targets. With polynomial axis sizes, logarithmic Gaussian parameters, phase gap Omega(p^-2) and g<=p^beta for fixed beta<1, the margin costs O(g log p)=o(p) bits. Cp-bit entry and factor-table rounding eventually preserve the obstruction.

## Novelty and sources
Quantitative extension of the exact boundary-minor package326844a. Exact canonical source pins and prior accretive-symbol/fine-prime attribution are retained, including #1786. No literature-wide priority claim.

## Checks
Registered exact normal/-O replay passes27 arbitrary-A cases,6 tensors,39 PSD gap certificates and substantive failure controls. Independent root proof/source review, eight canonical pins, byte/mode, ancestry and export checks pass.

## Limits
This concerns matrix representations, not arbitrary layouts, nonlinear rounded algorithms or runtime. Full gauged/periodic recovery and source-to-core transfer remain open. No practical source cutoff is claimed.

## Base, kappa and credit
Base e54523517d0f03e58352e647c403a5af3e525a57. No new kappa: selected0.00363005817 and all five assumptions remain. Prepared for @CubeJerry with substantial OpenAI assistance; separate-agent review is not human/formal acceptance. Full-history gate success is not claimed for the intentionally shallow checkout.
